#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
文档处理器 FastAPI 应用。

提供 RESTful API 接口用于：
- 文件上传和解析
- 文本分割
- LLM 文本润色处理
- 批量文档处理

API 端点：
- POST /api/v1/parse: 解析上传的文件
- POST /api/v1/split: 分割文本
- POST /api/v1/polish: 润色文本
- POST /api/v1/process: 完整处理流程
- GET /api/v1/health: 健康检查

Author: Document Processor Team
Version: 1.0.0
"""

import os
import uuid
import shutil
import logging
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import (
    FastAPI,
    File,
    UploadFile,
    HTTPException,
    BackgroundTasks,
    Query,
    Body,
)
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

# 导入文档处理器模块
from .config import DocumentProcessorConfig, SplitterConfig, LLMConfig
from .parsers import parse_document, ParsedDocument
from .splitters import RecursiveTextSplitter, TextChunk
from .llm import LLMClient
from .pipeline import DocumentProcessor


# ============================================================================
# 日志配置
# ============================================================================

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s",
    datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
)
logger = logging.getLogger("DocumentProcessorAPI")


# ============================================================================
# 配置
# ============================================================================

class AppConfig:
    """应用配置类。"""
    
    UPLOAD_DIR: str = os.getenv("UPLOAD_DIR", "/tmp/document_processor_uploads")
    MAX_FILE_SIZE: int = int(os.getenv("MAX_FILE_SIZE", str(50 * 1024 * 1024)))
    ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS: set = {".pdf", ".docx", ".doc", ".pptx", ".ppt", ".txt", ".md"}
    DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE: int = int(os.getenv("DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE", "512"))
    DEFAULT_OVERLAP_SIZE: int = int(os.getenv("DEFAULT_OVERLAP_SIZE", "64"))
    LLM_BASE_URL: str = os.getenv("LLM_BASE_URL", "https://xxx.com/gpt")
    LLM_API_KEY: str = os.getenv("LLM_API_KEY", "")
    LLM_MODEL: str = os.getenv("LLM_MODEL", "gpt-4")
    AUTO_CLEANUP: bool = os.getenv("AUTO_CLEANUP", "true").lower() == "true"


app_config = AppConfig()


# ============================================================================
# Pydantic 模型
# ============================================================================

class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    """健康检查响应模型。"""
    status: str = Field(..., description="服务状态")
    timestamp: str = Field(..., description="时间戳")
    version: str = Field(..., description="API 版本")


class TextSplitRequest(BaseModel):
    """文本分割请求模型。"""
    text: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="待分割的文本")
    chunk_size: int = Field(default=512, ge=64, le=8192, description="每个块的最大字符数")
    overlap_size: int = Field(default=64, ge=0, le=1024, description="块之间的重叠字符数")
    
    @field_validator("overlap_size")
    @classmethod
    def validate_overlap(cls, v: int, info) -> int:
        """验证 overlap_size 必须小于 chunk_size。"""
        chunk_size = info.data.get("chunk_size", 512)
        if v >= chunk_size:
            raise ValueError(f"overlap_size ({v}) 必须小于 chunk_size ({chunk_size})")
        return v


class TextChunkResponse(BaseModel):
    """文本块响应模型。"""
    content: str = Field(..., description="文本块内容")
    chunk_index: int = Field(..., description="块序号")
    character_count: int = Field(..., description="字符数")
    sentence_count: int = Field(..., description="句子数")
    overlap_with_previous: int = Field(..., description="与前一块的重叠字符数")


class TextSplitResponse(BaseModel):
    """文本分割响应模型。"""
    success: bool = Field(..., description="是否成功")
    original_length: int = Field(..., description="原文长度")
    chunk_count: int = Field(..., description="块数量")
    chunks: List[TextChunkResponse] = Field(..., description="文本块列表")
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="统计信息")


class TextPolishRequest(BaseModel):
    """文本润色请求模型。"""
    text_list: List[str] = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100, description="待润色的文本列表")
    prompt_name: str = Field(default="text_polish", description="使用的提示词名称")


class TextPolishResponse(BaseModel):
    """文本润色响应模型。"""
    success: bool = Field(..., description="是否成功")
    response_list: List[str] = Field(..., description="润色后的文本列表")
    processed_count: int = Field(..., description="成功处理的数量")
    failed_count: int = Field(..., description="失败的数量")
    errors: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="错误信息列表")


class FileParseResponse(BaseModel):
    """文件解析响应模型。"""
    success: bool = Field(..., description="是否成功")
    file_name: str = Field(..., description="文件名")
    file_type: str = Field(..., description="文件类型")
    text_content: str = Field(..., description="提取的文本内容")
    character_count: int = Field(..., description="字符数")
    page_count: int = Field(..., description="页面/幻灯片数")
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="元数据")
    error_message: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="错误信息")


class ProcessedFileResult(BaseModel):
    """单个文件处理结果模型。"""
    file_name: str = Field(..., description="文件名")
    success: bool = Field(..., description="是否成功")
    original_length: int = Field(default=0, description="原文长度")
    chunk_count: int = Field(default=0, description="块数量")
    text_list: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="处理后的文本列表")
    error_message: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="错误信息")


class ProcessResponse(BaseModel):
    """完整处理响应模型。"""
    success: bool = Field(..., description="是否成功")
    total_files: int = Field(..., description="总文件数")
    successful_files: int = Field(..., description="成功处理的文件数")
    results: List[ProcessedFileResult] = Field(..., description="各文件处理结果")
    total_text_list: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="所有文件处理后的文本列表")


# ============================================================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================================================

def validate_file_extension(filename: str) -> str:
    """验证文件扩展名。"""
    ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in app_config.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"不支持的文件类型: {ext}。支持的类型: {app_config.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS}"
        )
    return ext


async def save_upload_file(upload_file: UploadFile) -> str:
    """保存上传的文件。"""
    ext = validate_file_extension(upload_file.filename)
    os.makedirs(app_config.UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    
    unique_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    safe_filename = f"{timestamp}_{unique_id}{ext}"
    file_path = os.path.join(app_config.UPLOAD_DIR, safe_filename)
    
    content = await upload_file.read()
    if len(content) > app_config.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"文件大小超过限制: {len(content)} > {app_config.MAX_FILE_SIZE}"
        )
    
    with open(file_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(content)
    
    logger.info(f"文件已保存: {file_path} ({len(content)} bytes)")
    return file_path


def cleanup_file(file_path: str) -> None:
    """清理临时文件。"""
    try:
        if os.path.exists(file_path):
            os.remove(file_path)
            logger.debug(f"已清理临时文件: {file_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"清理文件失败: {file_path}, {e}")


def get_llm_client() -> Optional[LLMClient]:
    """获取 LLM 客户端。"""
    if not app_config.LLM_API_KEY:
        logger.warning("LLM API Key 未配置")
        return None
    
    config = LLMConfig(
        base_url=app_config.LLM_BASE_URL,
        api_key=app_config.LLM_API_KEY,
        model=app_config.LLM_MODEL,
    )
    return LLMClient(config=config)


def get_document_processor(
    chunk_size: int = 512,
    overlap_size: int = 64,
    llm_client: Optional[LLMClient] = None,
) -> DocumentProcessor:
    """获取文档处理器。"""
    config = DocumentProcessorConfig(
        splitter=SplitterConfig(chunk_size=chunk_size, overlap_size=overlap_size),
    )
    return DocumentProcessor(config=config, llm_client=llm_client)


# ============================================================================
# 应用生命周期
# ============================================================================

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """应用生命周期管理。"""
    logger.info("=" * 60)
    logger.info("文档处理器 API 服务启动")
    logger.info(f"上传目录: {app_config.UPLOAD_DIR}")
    logger.info(f"最大文件大小: {app_config.MAX_FILE_SIZE / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB")
    logger.info("=" * 60)
    
    os.makedirs(app_config.UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    yield
    
    logger.info("文档处理器 API 服务关闭")
    if app_config.AUTO_CLEANUP:
        shutil.rmtree(app_config.UPLOAD_DIR, ignore_errors=True)


# ============================================================================
# FastAPI 应用
# ============================================================================

app = FastAPI(
    title="文档处理器 API",
    description="提供文档解析、文本分割和 LLM 润色的 RESTful API 服务。",
    version="1.0.0",
    lifespan=lifespan,
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


# ============================================================================
# API 端点
# ============================================================================

@app.get("/api/v1/health", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=["系统"])
async def health_check():
    """健康检查端点。"""
    return HealthResponse(
        status="healthy",
        timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat(),
        version="1.0.0",
    )


@app.post("/api/v1/parse", response_model=FileParseResponse, tags=["文件处理"])
async def parse_file_endpoint(
    file: UploadFile = File(..., description="要解析的文件"),
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
):
    """解析上传的文件。"""
    logger.info(f"收到文件解析请求: {file.filename}")
    file_path = await save_upload_file(file)
    
    try:
        parsed_doc: ParsedDocument = parse_document(file_path)
        
        if not parsed_doc.success:
            return FileParseResponse(
                success=False,
                file_name=file.filename,
                file_type=parsed_doc.file_type,
                text_content="",
                character_count=0,
                page_count=0,
                error_message=parsed_doc.error_message,
            )
        
        logger.info(f"文件解析成功: {file.filename}, {parsed_doc.total_characters} 字符")
        
        return FileParseResponse(
            success=True,
            file_name=file.filename,
            file_type=parsed_doc.file_type,
            text_content=parsed_doc.text_content,
            character_count=parsed_doc.total_characters,
            page_count=parsed_doc.page_count,
            metadata=parsed_doc.metadata,
        )
    finally:
        if background_tasks and app_config.AUTO_CLEANUP:
            background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_file, file_path)


@app.post("/api/v1/split", response_model=TextSplitResponse, tags=["文本处理"])
async def split_text(request: TextSplitRequest):
    """分割文本。"""
    logger.info(f"收到文本分割请求: {len(request.text)} 字符")
    
    splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(
        chunk_size=request.chunk_size,
        overlap_size=request.overlap_size,
    )
    
    chunks: List[TextChunk] = splitter.split(request.text)
    stats = splitter.get_stats(chunks)
    
    chunk_responses = [
        TextChunkResponse(
            content=chunk.content,
            chunk_index=chunk.chunk_index,
            character_count=len(chunk.content),
            sentence_count=chunk.sentence_count,
            overlap_with_previous=chunk.overlap_with_previous,
        )
        for chunk in chunks
    ]
    
    logger.info(f"文本分割完成: {len(chunks)} 个块")
    
    return TextSplitResponse(
        success=True,
        original_length=len(request.text),
        chunk_count=len(chunks),
        chunks=chunk_responses,
        stats=stats,
    )


@app.post("/api/v1/polish", response_model=TextPolishResponse, tags=["文本处理"])
async def polish_texts(request: TextPolishRequest):
    """润色文本列表。"""
    logger.info(f"收到文本润色请求: {len(request.text_list)} 个文本")
    
    llm_client = get_llm_client()
    if llm_client is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="LLM 服务未配置")
    
    try:
        response_list = llm_client.process_chunks(
            text_list=request.text_list,
            prompt_name=request.prompt_name,
        )
        
        processed_count = len(response_list)
        failed_count = len(request.text_list) - processed_count
        
        return TextPolishResponse(
            success=True,
            response_list=response_list,
            processed_count=processed_count,
            failed_count=failed_count,
        )
    finally:
        llm_client.close()


@app.post("/api/v1/process", response_model=ProcessResponse, tags=["文件处理"])
async def process_files(
    files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="要处理的文件列表"),
    chunk_size: int = Query(default=512, ge=64, le=8192),
    overlap_size: int = Query(default=64, ge=0, le=1024),
    use_llm: bool = Query(default=False),
    prompt_name: str = Query(default="text_polish"),
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
):
    """完整处理上传的文件。"""
    logger.info(f"收到完整处理请求: {len(files)} 个文件")
    
    if overlap_size >= chunk_size:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"overlap_size ({overlap_size}) 必须小于 chunk_size ({chunk_size})"
        )
    
    saved_files: List[tuple] = []
    for file in files:
        try:
            file_path = await save_upload_file(file)
            saved_files.append((file.filename, file_path))
        except HTTPException as e:
            saved_files.append((file.filename, None))
    
    llm_client = get_llm_client() if use_llm else None
    
    try:
        processor = get_document_processor(chunk_size, overlap_size, llm_client)
        results: List[ProcessedFileResult] = []
        total_text_list: List[str] = []
        
        for original_name, file_path in saved_files:
            if file_path is None:
                results.append(ProcessedFileResult(
                    file_name=original_name, success=False, error_message="文件保存失败"
                ))
                continue
            
            try:
                processing_result = processor.process_file(
                    file_path=file_path, use_llm=use_llm, prompt_name=prompt_name
                )
                
                if processing_result.success:
                    results.append(ProcessedFileResult(
                        file_name=original_name,
                        success=True,
                        original_length=processing_result.total_characters,
                        chunk_count=processing_result.chunk_count,
                        text_list=processing_result.processed_texts,
                    ))
                    total_text_list.extend(processing_result.processed_texts)
                else:
                    results.append(ProcessedFileResult(
                        file_name=original_name,
                        success=False,
                        error_message=processing_result.error_message,
                    ))
            except Exception as e:
                results.append(ProcessedFileResult(
                    file_name=original_name, success=False, error_message=str(e)
                ))
        
        successful_files = sum(1 for r in results if r.success)
        
        return ProcessResponse(
            success=successful_files > 0,
            total_files=len(files),
            successful_files=successful_files,
            results=results,
            total_text_list=total_text_list,
        )
    finally:
        if background_tasks and app_config.AUTO_CLEANUP:
            for _, file_path in saved_files:
                if file_path:
                    background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_file, file_path)
        if llm_client:
            llm_client.close()


@app.post("/api/v1/process/text", response_model=ProcessResponse, tags=["文本处理"])
async def process_text_endpoint(
    text: str = Body(..., embed=True, description="要处理的文本"),
    chunk_size: int = Body(default=512, ge=64, le=8192),
    overlap_size: int = Body(default=64, ge=0, le=1024),
    use_llm: bool = Body(default=False),
    prompt_name: str = Body(default="text_polish"),
):
    """直接处理文本。"""
    logger.info(f"收到文本处理请求: {len(text)} 字符")
    
    if overlap_size >= chunk_size:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"overlap_size ({overlap_size}) 必须小于 chunk_size ({chunk_size})"
        )
    
    splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(chunk_size=chunk_size, overlap_size=overlap_size)
    chunks = splitter.split(text)
    chunk_texts = [chunk.content for chunk in chunks]
    
    processed_texts = chunk_texts
    if use_llm:
        llm_client = get_llm_client()
        if llm_client:
            try:
                processed_texts = llm_client.process_chunks(
                    text_list=chunk_texts, prompt_name=prompt_name
                )
            finally:
                llm_client.close()
    
    return ProcessResponse(
        success=True,
        total_files=1,
        successful_files=1,
        results=[ProcessedFileResult(
            file_name="<direct_text>",
            success=True,
            original_length=len(text),
            chunk_count=len(chunks),
            text_list=processed_texts,
        )],
        total_text_list=processed_texts,
    )


# ============================================================================
# 错误处理
# ============================================================================

@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
async def http_exception_handler(request, exc: HTTPException):
    """HTTP 异常处理器。"""
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        content={"success": False, "error": exc.detail, "status_code": exc.status_code},
    )


@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def general_exception_handler(request, exc: Exception):
    """通用异常处理器。"""
    logger.error(f"未处理的异常: {exc}", exc_info=True)
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=500,
        content={"success": False, "error": "服务器内部错误", "detail": str(exc)},
    )


# ============================================================================
# 入口点
# ============================================================================

def main():
    """主入口函数。"""
    import uvicorn
    
    host = os.getenv("HOST", "0.0.0.0")
    port = int(os.getenv("PORT", "8000"))
    reload = os.getenv("RELOAD", "false").lower() == "true"
    
    logger.info(f"启动服务: {host}:{port}")
    uvicorn.run("document_processor.app:app", host=host, port=port, reload=reload)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
文档处理器 FastAPI 应用。

提供 RESTful API 接口用于文档解析、文本分割和 LLM 处理。

主要接口：
- POST /api/v1/parse: 解析上传的文档
- POST /api/v1/split: 分割文本
- POST /api/v1/process: 完整处理流水线
- POST /api/v1/polish: LLM 文本润色

启动方式：
    uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

Author: Document Processor Team
Version: 1.0.0
"""

import os
import sys
import logging
import tempfile
import shutil
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any
from pathlib import Path
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import (
    FastAPI,
    File,
    UploadFile,
    HTTPException,
    BackgroundTasks,
    Query,
    Body,
    Depends,
)
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

# 导入文档处理模块
from document_processor import (
    DocumentProcessor,
    DocumentProcessorConfig,
    SplitterConfig,
    LLMConfig,
    RecursiveTextSplitter,
    TextChunk,
    ParsedDocument,
    LLMClient,
    LLMResponse,
    parse_document,
    process_documents,
)


# ============================================================================
# 日志配置
# ============================================================================

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s",
    datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
)
logger = logging.getLogger("DocumentProcessorAPI")


# ============================================================================
# Pydantic 模型定义
# ============================================================================

class SplitRequest(BaseModel):
    """
    文本分割请求模型。
    
    Attributes:
        text: 待分割的文本。
        chunk_size: 块大小，默认 512。
        overlap_size: 重叠大小，默认 64。
    """
    
    text: str = Field(..., description="待分割的文本", min_length=1)
    chunk_size: int = Field(default=512, description="块大小", ge=50, le=10000)
    overlap_size: int = Field(default=64, description="重叠大小", ge=0, le=500)
    
    @field_validator('overlap_size')
    @classmethod
    def validate_overlap(cls, v: int, info) -> int:
        """验证重叠大小必须小于块大小。"""
        chunk_size = info.data.get('chunk_size', 512)
        if v >= chunk_size:
            raise ValueError(f"overlap_size ({v}) 必须小于 chunk_size ({chunk_size})")
        return v


class ChunkResponse(BaseModel):
    """
    文本块响应模型。
    
    Attributes:
        content: 块内容。
        chunk_index: 块索引。
        character_count: 字符数。
        overlap_with_previous: 与前一块的重叠字符数。
        sentence_count: 句子数量。
    """
    
    content: str = Field(..., description="块内容")
    chunk_index: int = Field(..., description="块索引")
    character_count: int = Field(..., description="字符数")
    overlap_with_previous: int = Field(default=0, description="重叠字符数")
    sentence_count: int = Field(default=0, description="句子数量")


class SplitResponse(BaseModel):
    """
    文本分割响应模型。
    
    Attributes:
        success: 是否成功。
        chunks: 文本块列表。
        total_chunks: 总块数。
        original_length: 原文长度。
        stats: 分割统计信息。
    """
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    chunks: List[ChunkResponse] = Field(default_factory=list, description="文本块列表")
    total_chunks: int = Field(default=0, description="总块数")
    original_length: int = Field(default=0, description="原文长度")
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="统计信息")
    message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="消息")


class PolishRequest(BaseModel):
    """
    文本润色请求模型。
    
    Attributes:
        text_list: 待润色的文本列表。
        prompt_name: 使用的提示词名称。
    """
    
    text_list: List[str] = Field(..., description="待润色的文本列表", min_length=1)
    prompt_name: str = Field(
        default="text_polish",
        description="提示词名称: text_polish, text_polish_preserve_format, text_reorganize, text_fix_ocr"
    )


class PolishResponse(BaseModel):
    """
    文本润色响应模型。
    
    Attributes:
        success: 是否成功。

    """
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    response_list: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="润色后的文本列表")
    total_processed: int = Field(default=0, description="处理数量")
    failed_count: int = Field(default=0, description="失败数量")
    message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="消息")


class ParseResponse(BaseModel):

    文档解析响应模型。
    
    Attributes:
        success: 是否成功。
        file_name: 文件名。
        file_type: 文件类型。
        text_content: 提取的文本。
        character_count: 字符数。
        page_count: 页数。
        metadata: 元数据。
    """
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    file_name: str = Field(..., description="文件名")
    file_type: str = Field(..., description="文件类型")
    text_content: str = Field(default="", description="提取的文本")
    character_count: int = Field(default=0, description="字符数")
    page_count: int = Field(default=0, description="页数")
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="元数据")
    error_message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="错误信息")


class ProcessRequest(BaseModel):
    """
    完整处理请求模型（用于文本输入）。
    
    Attributes:
        text: 待处理的文本。
        chunk_size: 块大小。
        overlap_size: 重叠大小。
        use_llm: 是否使用 LLM 处理。
        prompt_name: 提示词名称。
    """
    
    text: str = Field(..., description="待处理的文本", min_length=1)
    chunk_size: int = Field(default=512, description="块大小", ge=50, le=10000)
    overlap_size: int = Field(default=64, description="重叠大小", ge=0, le=500)
    use_llm: bool = Field(default=False, description="是否使用 LLM")
    prompt_name: str = Field(default="text_polish", description="提示词名称")


class ProcessResponse(BaseModel):
    """
    完整处理响应模型。
    
    Attributes:
        success: 是否成功。
        text_list: 处理后的文本列表。
        chunks: 分割后的文本块。
        total_chunks: 总块数。
        original_length: 原文长度。
        llm_processed: 是否经过 LLM 处理。
    """
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    text_list: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="处理后的文本列表")
    chunks: List[ChunkResponse] = Field(default_factory=list, description="文本块列表")
    total_chunks: int = Field(default=0, description="总块数")
    original_length: int = Field(default=0, description="原文长度")
    llm_processed: bool = Field(default=False, description="是否 LLM 处理")
    message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="消息")


class BatchParseResponse(BaseModel):
    """
    批量解析响应模型。
    
    Attributes:
        success: 是否成功。
        results: 解析结果列表。
        total_files: 文件总数。
        successful_count: 成功数量。
        failed_count: 失败数量。
    """
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    results: List[ParseResponse] = Field(default_factory=list, description="结果列表")
    total_files: int = Field(default=0, description="文件总数")
    successful_count: int = Field(default=0, description="成功数量")
    failed_count: int = Field(default=0, description="失败数量")


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    """健康检查响应模型。"""
    
    status: str = Field(default="healthy", description="服务状态")
    version: str = Field(default="1.0.0", description="版本号")
    components: Dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="组件状态")


class ConfigResponse(BaseModel):
    """配置信息响应模型。"""
    
    splitter: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="分割器配置")
    llm: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="LLM 配置")
    parser: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="解析器配置")


# ============================================================================
# 全局状态和依赖注入
# ============================================================================

class AppState:
    """
    应用全局状态。
    
    管理处理器实例和配置。
    """
    
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """初始化应用状态。"""
        self.config = DocumentProcessorConfig()
        self.processor: Optional[DocumentProcessor] = None
        self.llm_client: Optional[LLMClient] = None
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="doc_processor_")
        
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        """初始化处理器。"""
        # 检查是否配置了 LLM
        llm_base_url = os.getenv("LLM_BASE_URL", "")
        llm_api_key = os.getenv("LLM_API_KEY", "")
        
        if llm_base_url:
            try:
                self.config.llm = LLMConfig(
                    base_url=llm_base_url,
                    api_key=llm_api_key,
                    model=os.getenv("LLM_MODEL", "gpt-4"),
                )
                self.llm_client = LLMClient(config=self.config.llm)
                logger.info(f"LLM 客户端已初始化: {llm_base_url}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"LLM 客户端初始化失败: {e}")
        
        # 初始化处理器
        self.processor = DocumentProcessor(
            config=self.config,
            llm_client=self.llm_client,
        )
        
        logger.info("文档处理器已初始化")
    
    def cleanup(self) -> None:
        """清理资源。"""
        if self.llm_client:
            self.llm_client.close()
        
        if os.path.exists(self.temp_dir):
            shutil.rmtree(self.temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
        
        logger.info("资源已清理")


# 全局状态实例
app_state = AppState()


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """
    应用生命周期管理。
    
    在应用启动时初始化资源，关闭时清理资源。
    """
    # 启动时
    logger.info("正在启动文档处理器 API 服务...")
    app_state.initialize()
    
    yield
    
    # 关闭时
    logger.info("正在关闭文档处理器 API 服务...")
    app_state.cleanup()


# ============================================================================
# FastAPI 应用
# ============================================================================

app = FastAPI(
    title="文档处理器 API",
    description="""
## 文档处理器 API

提供文档解析、文本分割和 LLM 处理的 RESTful API 接口。

### 主要功能

### 使用流程

1. 上传文档进行解析 (`/api/v1/parse`)
2. 对提取的文本进行分割 (`/api/v1/split`)
3. 可选：使用 LLM 进行文本润色 (`/api/v1/polish`)
4. 或者使用一站式接口 (`/api/v1/process`)

### 配置说明

通过环境变量配置 LLM：
- `LLM_BASE_URL`: LLM API 地址
- `LLM_API_KEY`: API 密钥
- `LLM_MODEL`: 模型名称
    """,
    version="1.0.0",
    lifespan=lifespan,
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
)

# CORS 配置
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


# ============================================================================
# 辅助函数
# ============================================================================

def get_processor() -> DocumentProcessor:
    """
    获取文档处理器实例。
    
    Returns:
        DocumentProcessor 实例。
        
    Raises:
        HTTPException: 处理器未初始化时抛出。
    """
    if app_state.processor is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=503,
            detail="文档处理器未初始化"
        )
    return app_state.processor


def get_llm_client() -> Optional[LLMClient]:
    """
    获取 LLM 客户端实例。
    
    Returns:
        LLMClient 实例或 None。
    """
    return app_state.llm_client


async def save_upload_file(upload_file: UploadFile) -> str:
    """
    保存上传的文件到临时目录。
    
    Args:
        upload_file: 上传的文件。
        
    Returns:
        保存后的文件路径。
    """
    # 生成安全的文件名
    file_name = upload_file.filename or "uploaded_file"
    safe_name = Path(file_name).name  # 移除路径
    
    file_path = os.path.join(app_state.temp_dir, safe_name)
    
    # 确保不会覆盖已有文件
    base, ext = os.path.splitext(file_path)
    counter = 1
    while os.path.exists(file_path):
        file_path = f"{base}_{counter}{ext}"
        counter += 1
    
    # 保存文件
    with open(file_path, "wb") as f:
        content = await upload_file.read()
        f.write(content)
    
    return file_path


def cleanup_file(file_path: str) -> None:
    """
    清理临时文件。
    
    Args:
        file_path: 文件路径。
    """
    try:
        if os.path.exists(file_path):
            os.remove(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"清理临时文件失败: {file_path}, {e}")


def chunk_to_response(chunk: TextChunk) -> ChunkResponse:
    """
    将 TextChunk 转换为响应模型。
    
    Args:
        chunk: 文本块。
        
    Returns:
        ChunkResponse 对象。
    """
    return ChunkResponse(
        content=chunk.content,
        chunk_index=chunk.chunk_index,
        character_count=len(chunk.content),
        overlap_with_previous=chunk.overlap_with_previous,
        sentence_count=chunk.sentence_count,
    )


# ============================================================================
# API 端点
# ============================================================================

@app.get("/", tags=["Root"])
async def root():
    """根路径，返回 API 信息。"""
    return {
        "name": "文档处理器 API",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "docs": "/docs",
        "health": "/health",
    }


@app.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=["System"])
async def health_check():
    """
    健康检查接口。
    
    检查服务和各组件的运行状态。
    """
    components = {
        "processor": "healthy" if app_state.processor else "not_initialized",
        "llm_client": "healthy" if app_state.llm_client else "not_configured",
    }
    
    return HealthResponse(
        status="healthy",
        version="1.0.0",

@app.post("/api/v1/parse", response_model=ParseResponse, tags=["Document"])
async def parse_document_endpoint(
    file: UploadFile = File(..., description="待解析的文档文件"),
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
):
    """
    解析上传的文档。
    
    支持的文件格式：
    - PDF (.pdf)
    - Word (.docx, .doc)
    - PowerPoint (.pptx, .ppt)
    - 文本文件 (.txt, .md)
    
    Returns:
        解析结果，包含提取的文本和元数据。
    """
    logger.info(f"收到文档解析请求: {file.filename}")
    
    # 验证文件类型
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="文件名不能为空")
    
    ext = os.path.splitext(file.filename)[1].lower()
    supported = app_state.config.parser.supported_extensions
    
    if ext not in supported:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"不支持的文件类型: {ext}。支持: {supported}"
        )
    
    # 保存上传文件
    file_path = await save_upload_file(file)
    
    try:
        # 解析文档
        result = parse_document(file_path)
        
        if not result.success:
            return ParseResponse(
                success=False,
                file_name=file.filename,
                file_type=ext,
                error_message=result.error_message,
            )
        
        logger.info(
            f"文档解析成功: {file.filename}, "
            f"{len(result.text_content)} 字符"
        )
        
        return ParseResponse(
            success=True,
            file_name=file.filename,
            file_type=ext,
            text_content=result.text_content,
            character_count=len(result.text_content),
            page_count=result.page_count,
            metadata=result.metadata,
        )
        
    finally:
        # 后台清理临时文件
        if background_tasks:
            background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_file, file_path)
        else:
            cleanup_file(file_path)


@app.post("/api/v1/parse/batch", response_model=BatchParseResponse, tags=["Document"])
async def parse_documents_batch(
    files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="待解析的文档文件列表"),
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
):
    """
    批量解析多个文档。
    
    一次上传多个文件进行解析。
    
    Returns:
        所有文件的解析结果。
    """
    logger.info(f"收到批量解析请求: {len(files)} 个文件")
    
    results = []
    file_paths = []
    
    try:
        for file in files:
            if not file.filename:
                results.append(ParseResponse(
                    success=False,
                    file_name="unknown",
                    file_type="",
                    error_message="文件名为空",
                ))
                continue
            
            ext = os.path.splitext(file.filename)[1].lower()
            
            # 保存文件
            file_path = await save_upload_file(file)
            file_paths.append(file_path)
            
            # 解析
            try:
                result = parse_document(file_path)
                
                results.append(ParseResponse(
                    success=result.success,
                    file_name=file.filename,
                    file_type=ext,
                    text_content=result.text_content if result.success else "",
                    character_count=len(result.text_content) if result.success else 0,
                    page_count=result.page_count,
                    metadata=result.metadata,
                    error_message=result.error_message,
                ))
                
            except Exception as e:
                results.append(ParseResponse(
                    success=False,
                    file_name=file.filename,
                    file_type=ext,
                    error_message=str(e),
                ))
        
        successful = sum(1 for r in results if r.success)
        
        return BatchParseResponse(
            success=True,
            results=results,
            total_files=len(files),
            successful_count=successful,
            failed_count=len(files) - successful,
        )
        
    finally:
        # 清理所有临时文件
        for fp in file_paths:
            if background_tasks:
                background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_file, fp)
            else:
                cleanup_file(fp)


@app.post("/api/v1/split", response_model=SplitResponse, tags=["Text Processing"])
async def split_text(request: SplitRequest):
    """
    分割文本为多个块。
    
    使用基于中英文句子边界的递归分割算法，确保：
    - 每个块不超过 chunk_size
    - 块之间有 overlap_size 的重叠
    - 重叠部分保持完整句子
    
    Returns:
        分割后的文本块列表和统计信息。
    """
    logger.info(
        f"收到文本分割请求: {len(request.text)} 字符, "
        f"chunk_size={request.chunk_size}, overlap_size={request.overlap_size}"
    )
    
    try:
        # 创建分割器
        splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(
            chunk_size=request.chunk_size,
            overlap_size=request.overlap_size,
        )
        
        # 分割文本
        chunks = splitter.split(request.text)
        
        # 获取统计信息
        stats = splitter.get_stats(chunks)
        
        # 转换为响应模型
        chunk_responses = [chunk_to_response(c) for c in chunks]
        
        logger.info(f"文本分割完成: {len(chunks)} 个块")
        
        return SplitResponse(
            success=True,
            chunks=chunk_responses,
            total_chunks=len(chunks),
            original_length=len(request.text),
            stats=stats,
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"文本分割失败: {e}", exc_info=True)
        return SplitResponse(
            success=False,
            message=str(e),
        )


@app.post("/api/v1/polish", response_model=PolishResponse, tags=["LLM"])
async def polish_texts(request: PolishRequest):
    """
    使用 LLM 润色文本。
    
    输入 text_list，输出 response_list。
    在不减少或改变原文信息的前提下，润色优化提取的原文。
    
    可用的提示词：
    - text_polish: 默认润色
    - text_polish_preserve_format: 保持格式的润色
    - text_reorganize: 重组文本结构
    - text_fix_ocr: 修复 OCR 错误
    
    Returns:
        润色后的文本列表。
    """
    logger.info(
        f"收到文本润色请求: {len(request.text_list)} 个文本, "
        f"prompt={request.prompt_name}"
    )
    
    # 检查 LLM 是否可用
    if not app_state.llm_client:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=503,
            detail="LLM 服务未配置。请设置环境变量 LLM_BASE_URL 和 LLM_API_KEY"
        )
    
    try:
        # 调用 LLM 处理
        response_list = app_state.llm_client.process_chunks(
            text_list=request.text_list,
            prompt_name=request.prompt_name,
        )
        
        # 统计失败数量（如果返回的文本与原文相同，可能是处理失败）
        failed_count = sum(
            1 for orig, resp in zip(request.text_list, response_list)
            if orig == resp
        )
        
        logger.info(
            f"文本润色完成: {len(response_list)} 个, "
            f"失败 {failed_count} 个"
        )
        
        return PolishResponse(
            success=True,
            response_list=response_list,
            total_processed=len(response_list),
            failed_count=failed_count,
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"文本润色失败: {e}", exc_info=True)
        return PolishResponse(
            success=False,
            message=str(e),
        )


@app.post("/api/v1/process", response_model=ProcessResponse, tags=["Pipeline"])
async def process_text(request: ProcessRequest):
    """
    完整处理文本。
    
    一站式接口：分割 + 可选的 LLM 润色。
    
    流程：
    1. 根据配置分割文本
    2. 如果 use_llm=true，对每个块进行 LLM 润色
    3. 返回处理后的文本列表
    
    Returns:
        处理后的文本列表和分割信息。
    """
    logger.info(
        f"收到完整处理请求: {len(request.text)} 字符, "
        f"use_llm={request.use_llm}"
    )
    
    try:
        # 分割文本
        splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(
            chunk_size=request.chunk_size,
            overlap_size=request.overlap_size,
        )
        chunks = splitter.split(request.text)
        
        # 提取文本
        text_list = [c.content for c in chunks]
        
        # LLM 处理（如果启用）
        llm_processed = False
        if request.use_llm and app_state.llm_client:
            text_list = app_state.llm_client.process_chunks(
                text_list=text_list,
                prompt_name=request.prompt_name,
            )
            llm_processed = True
        elif request.use_llm and not app_state.llm_client:
            logger.warning("请求使用 LLM 但服务未配置")
        
        # 构建响应
        chunk_responses = [chunk_to_response(c) for c in chunks]
        
        logger.info(
            f"文本处理完成: {len(chunks)} 个块, "
            f"LLM 处理: {llm_processed}"
        )
        
        return ProcessResponse(
            success=True,
            text_list=text_list,
            chunks=chunk_responses,
            total_chunks=len(chunks),
            original_length=len(request.text),
            llm_processed=llm_processed,
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"文本处理失败: {e}", exc_info=True)
        return ProcessResponse(
            success=False,
            message=str(e),
        )


@app.post("/api/v1/process/file", response_model=ProcessResponse, tags=["Pipeline"])
async def process_file(
    file: UploadFile = File(..., description="待处理的文档文件"),
    chunk_size: int = Query(default=512, ge=50, le=10000, description="块大小"),
    overlap_size: int = Query(default=64, ge=0, le=500, description="重叠大小"),
    use_llm: bool = Query(default=False, description="是否使用 LLM"),
    prompt_name: str = Query(default="text_polish", description="提示词名称"),
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
):
    """
    完整处理文件。
    
    一站式接口：解析 + 分割 + 可选的 LLM 润色。
    
    流程：
    1. 解析上传的文档
    2. 分割提取的文本
    3. 如果 use_llm=true，对每个块进行 LLM 润色
    
    Returns:
        处理后的文本列表和分割信息。
    """
    logger.info(
        f"收到文件处理请求: {file.filename}, "
        f"chunk_size={chunk_size}, use_llm={use_llm}"
    )
    
    # 验证文件
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="文件名不能为空")
    
    ext = os.path.splitext(file.filename)[1].lower()
    supported = app_state.config.parser.supported_extensions
    
    if ext not in supported:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"不支持的文件类型: {ext}"
        )
    
    # 保存文件
    file_path = await save_upload_file(file)
    
    try:
        # 解析文档
        parsed = parse_document(file_path)
        
        if not parsed.success:
            return ProcessResponse(
                success=False,
                message=f"文档解析失败: {parsed.error_message}",
            )
        
        # 分割文本
        splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(
            chunk_size=chunk_size,
            overlap_size=overlap_size,
        )
        chunks = splitter.split(parsed.text_content)
        
        # 提取文本
        text_list = [c.content for c in chunks]
        
        # LLM 处理
        llm_processed = False
        if use_llm and app_state.llm_client:
            text_list = app_state.llm_client.process_chunks(
                text_list=text_list,
                prompt_name=prompt_name,
            )
            llm_processed = True
        
        # 构建响应
        chunk_responses = [chunk_to_response(c) for c in chunks]
        
        logger.info(
            f"文件处理完成: {file.filename}, "
            f"{len(chunks)} 个块"
        )
        
        return ProcessResponse(
            success=True,
            text_list=text_list,
            chunks=chunk_responses,
            total_chunks=len(chunks),
            original_length=len(parsed.text_content),
            llm_processed=llm_processed,
        )
        
    finally:
        if background_tasks:
            background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_file, file_path)
        else:
            cleanup_file(file_path)


# ============================================================================
# 错误处理
# ============================================================================

@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
async def http_exception_handler(request, exc: HTTPException):
    """HTTP 异常处理。"""
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        content={
            "success": False,
            "error": exc.detail,
            "status_code": exc.status_code,
        },
    )


@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def general_exception_handler(request, exc: Exception):
    """通用异常处理。"""
    logger.error(f"未处理的异常: {exc}", exc_info=True)
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=500,
        content={
            "success": False,
            "error": "服务器内部错误",
            "detail": str(exc),
        },
    )

        host=host,
        port=port,
        reload=reload,
        log_level="info",
    )

# 文档处理器 (Document Processor)

一个工业级的文档处理解决方案，支持多种文档格式解析、智能文本分割和 LLM 驱动的文本润色。

## 功能特性

### 📄 多格式文档解析
- **PDF**: 使用 PyMuPDF (fitz) 进行高质量文本提取
- **Word**: 支持 .docx 和 .doc 格式
- **PowerPoint**: 支持 .pptx 和 .ppt 格式
- **文本文件**: 支持 .txt、.md 等格式，自动检测编码

### ✂️ 智能文本分割
- 基于中英文句子边界的递归分割算法
- 保证重叠部分为完整句子，不会截断
- 可配置的块大小 (chunk_size) 和重叠大小 (overlap_size)
- 自动处理超长句子

### 🤖 LLM 文本润色
- 在不减少或改变原文信息的前提下优化文本
- 多种预定义提示词模板
- 支持批量处理和并发请求
- 完整的错误处理和重试机制

### 🚀 FastAPI 服务
- RESTful API 接口
- 完整的 OpenAPI 文档
- 文件上传和批量处理支持
- 健康检查和配置查询

## 安装

```bash
# 克隆项目
git clone <repository_url>
cd document_processor

# 安装依赖
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## 快速开始

### Python API 使用

#### 基本使用

```python
from document_processor import process_documents

# 处理文件列表
file_list = ["doc1.pdf", "doc2.docx", "doc3.pptx"]
text_list, results = process_documents(
    file_list=file_list,
    chunk_size=512,
    overlap_size=64,
)

# 输出处理后的文本
for text in text_list:
    print(text)
```

#### 高级使用

```python
from document_processor import (
    DocumentProcessor,
    DocumentProcessorConfig,
    SplitterConfig,
    LLMConfig,
    LLMClient,
)

# 自定义配置
config = DocumentProcessorConfig(
    splitter=SplitterConfig(
        chunk_size=1024,
        overlap_size=128,
    ),
)

# 配置 LLM（可选）
llm_config = LLMConfig(
    base_url="https://xxx.com/gpt",
    api_key="your-api-key",
    model="gpt-4",
)
llm_client = LLMClient(config=llm_config)

# 创建处理器
processor = DocumentProcessor(
    config=config,
    llm_client=llm_client,
)

# 处理文件
results = processor.process_files(
    file_list=["document.pdf"],
    use_llm=True,
    prompt_name="text_polish",
)

# 获取结果
for result in results:
    print(f"文件: {result.file_name}")
    print(f"块数: {result.chunk_count}")
    print(f"原文长度: {result.total_characters}")
    
    # 获取处理后的文本
    for i, text in enumerate(result.processed_texts):
        print(f"块 {i}: {text[:100]}...")
```

#### 单独使用文本分割器

```python
from document_processor import RecursiveTextSplitter

# 创建分割器
splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(
    chunk_size=512,
    overlap_size=64,
)

# 分割文本
text = """
人工智能（AI）是计算机科学的一个分支。它试图理解智能的实质，
并生产出一种新的能以人类智能相似的方式做出反应的智能机器。
该领域的研究包括机器人、语言识别、图像识别、自然语言处理等。
"""

chunks = splitter.split(text)

for chunk in chunks:
    print(f"块 {chunk.chunk_index}:")
    print(f"  内容: {chunk.content[:50]}...")
    print(f"  长度: {len(chunk.content)}")
    print(f"  重叠: {chunk.overlap_with_previous}")
    print(f"  句子数: {chunk.sentence_count}")

# 获取统计信息
stats = splitter.get_stats(chunks)
print(f"统计: {stats}")
```

#### 单独使用文档解析器

```python
from document_processor import (
    DocumentParserFactory,
    PDFParser,

    print(f"文本: {result.text_content[:200]}...")
    print(f"页数: {result.page_count}")
    print(f"元数据: {result.metadata}")
else:
    print(f"错误: {result.error_message}")

# 或使用便捷函数
result = parse_document("document.docx")

# 直接使用特定解析器
pdf_parser = PDFParser()
result = pdf_parser.parse("document.pdf")
```

### FastAPI 服务

#### 启动服务

```bash
# 基本启动
cd document_processor
uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

# 开发模式（自动重载）
uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

# 配置 LLM（可选）
export LLM_BASE_URL="https://xxx.com/gpt"
export LLM_API_KEY="your-api-key"
export LLM_MODEL="gpt-4"
uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

#### API 端点

| 端点 | 方法 | 描述 |
|------|------|------|
| `/health` | GET | 健康检查 |
| `/config` | GET | 获取配置信息 |
| `/api/v1/parse` | POST | 解析单个文档 |
| `/api/v1/parse/batch` | POST | 批量解析文档 |
| `/api/v1/split` | POST | 分割文本 |
| `/api/v1/polish` | POST | LLM 文本润色 |
| `/api/v1/process` | POST | 完整处理（文本输入） |
| `/api/v1/process/file` | POST | 完整处理（文件上传） |

#### API 使用示例

```python
import requests

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8000"

# 1. 解析文档
with open("document.pdf", "rb") as f:
    response = requests.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/parse",
        files={"file": f}
    )
    result = response.json()
    text = result["text_content"]

# 2. 分割文本
response = requests.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/split",
    json={
        "text": text,
        "chunk_size": 512,
        "overlap_size": 64,
    }
)
chunks = response.json()["chunks"]

# 3. LLM 润色（如果已配置）
response = requests.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/polish",
    json={
        "text_list": [c["content"] for c in chunks],
        "prompt_name": "text_polish",
    }
)
polished_texts = response.json()["response_list"]

# 4. 一站式处理
with open("document.pdf", "rb") as f:
    response = requests.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/process/file",
        files={"file": f},
        params={
            "chunk_size": 512,
            "overlap_size": 64,
            "use_llm": True,
        }
    )
    result = response.json()
    text_list = result["text_list"]
```

#### cURL 示例

```bash
# 健康检查
curl http://localhost:8000/health

# 解析文档
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/parse \
  -F "file=@document.pdf"

# 分割文本

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text": "这是测试文本。第二句话。", "chunk_size": 100}'

# 完整处理
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/process/file?chunk_size=512&use_llm=false" \
  -F "file=@document.pdf"
```

## 文本分割算法

### 核心特性

1. **句子完整性保证**: 重叠部分始终为完整句子
2. **中英文混合支持**: 智能识别中英文标点符号
3. **递归分割策略**: 按优先级使用不同分隔符

### 分隔符优先级

1. 段落分隔符: `\n\n`
2. 强句子分隔符: `。` `.` `！` `!` `？` `?`
3. 中等分隔符: `；` `;` `：` `:`
4. 弱分隔符: `，` `,` `、`
5. 空格
6. 强制字符切分（最后手段）

### 重叠策略

```
原始文本: [句子1。句子2。句子3。句子4。句子5。]

块 1: [句子1。句子2。句子3。]
块 2: [句子3。句子4。句子5。]  <- 句子3 作为完整重叠
```

- 如果单个句子超过 `overlap_size`，仍保留完整句子
- 如果多个句子超过 `overlap_size`，减少句子数量

## LLM 提示词

### 预定义提示词

| 名称 | 描述 |
|------|------|
| `text_polish` | 默认润色，保留所有信息 |
| `text_polish_preserve_format` | 保持原有格式的润色 |
| `text_reorganize` | 重组文本结构 |
| `text_fix_ocr` | 修复 OCR 提取错误 |

### 自定义提示词

```python
from document_processor import PromptManager

manager = PromptManager()

# 注册自定义提示词
manager.register_prompt(
    name="my_prompt",
    system_prompt="你是一个专业的编辑...",
    user_template="请处理: $text",
    description="我的自定义提示词",
)

# 使用自定义提示词
prompt = manager.get_prompt("my_prompt")
```

## 配置说明

### 环境变量

```python
from document_processor import (

    SplitterConfig,
    LLMConfig,
)

config = DocumentProcessorConfig(

)
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
文档处理器 FastAPI 应用。

提供 RESTful API 接口用于文档解析、文本分割和 LLM 处理。

主要接口：
- POST /api/v1/parse: 解析上传的文档
- POST /api/v1/split: 分割文本
- POST /api/v1/process: 完整处理流水线
- POST /api/v1/polish: LLM 文本润色

启动方式：
    uvicorn document_processor.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

Author: Document Processor Team
Version: 1.0.0
"""

import os
import sys
import logging
import tempfile
import shutil
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any
from pathlib import Path
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import (
    FastAPI,
    File,
    UploadFile,
    HTTPException,
    BackgroundTasks,
    Query,
    Body,
    Depends,
)
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

# 导入文档处理器模块（支持包导入和直接运行）
try:
    from document_processor import (
        DocumentProcessor,
        DocumentProcessorConfig,
        SplitterConfig,
        LLMConfig,
        RecursiveTextSplitter,
        TextChunk,
        LLMClient,
        parse_document,
        ParsedDocument,
    )
except ImportError:
    from . import (
        DocumentProcessor,
        DocumentProcessorConfig,
        SplitterConfig,
        LLMConfig,
        RecursiveTextSplitter,
        TextChunk,
        LLMClient,
        parse_document,
        ParsedDocument,
    )


# ============================================================================
# 日志配置
# ============================================================================

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s",
    datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
)
logger = logging.getLogger("DocumentProcessorAPI")


# ============================================================================
# Pydantic 模型定义
# ============================================================================

class SplitRequest(BaseModel):
    """文本分割请求模型。"""
    
    text: str = Field(..., description="待分割的文本", min_length=1)
    chunk_size: int = Field(default=512, description="块大小", ge=50, le=10000)
    overlap_size: int = Field(default=64, description="重叠大小", ge=0, le=500)
    
    @field_validator('overlap_size')
    @classmethod
    def validate_overlap(cls, v: int, info) -> int:
        """验证重叠大小必须小于块大小。"""
        chunk_size = info.data.get('chunk_size', 512)
        if v >= chunk_size:
            raise ValueError(f"overlap_size ({v}) 必须小于 chunk_size ({chunk_size})")
        return v


class ChunkResponse(BaseModel):
    """文本块响应模型。"""
    
    content: str = Field(..., description="块内容")
    chunk_index: int = Field(..., description="块索引")
    character_count: int = Field(..., description="字符数")
    overlap_with_previous: int = Field(default=0, description="重叠字符数")
    sentence_count: int = Field(default=0, description="句子数量")


class SplitResponse(BaseModel):
    """文本分割响应模型。"""
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    chunks: List[ChunkResponse] = Field(default_factory=list, description="文本块列表")
    total_chunks: int = Field(default=0, description="总块数")
    original_length: int = Field(default=0, description="原文长度")
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="统计信息")
    message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="消息")


class PolishRequest(BaseModel):
    """文本润色请求模型。"""
    
    text_list: List[str] = Field(..., description="待润色的文本列表", min_length=1)
    prompt_name: str = Field(default="text_polish", description="提示词名称")


class PolishResponse(BaseModel):
    """文本润色响应模型。"""
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    response_list: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="润色后的文本列表")
    total_processed: int = Field(default=0, description="处理数量")
    failed_count: int = Field(default=0, description="失败数量")
    message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="消息")


class ParseResponse(BaseModel):
    """文档解析响应模型。"""
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    file_name: str = Field(..., description="文件名")
    file_type: str = Field(..., description="文件类型")
    text_content: str = Field(default="", description="提取的文本")
    character_count: int = Field(default=0, description="字符数")
    page_count: int = Field(default=0, description="页数")
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="元数据")
    error_message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="错误信息")


class ProcessRequest(BaseModel):
    """完整处理请求模型（文本输入）。"""
    
    text: str = Field(..., description="待处理的文本", min_length=1)
    chunk_size: int = Field(default=512, description="块大小", ge=50, le=10000)
    overlap_size: int = Field(default=64, description="重叠大小", ge=0, le=500)
    use_llm: bool = Field(default=False, description="是否使用 LLM")
    prompt_name: str = Field(default="text_polish", description="提示词名称")


class ProcessResponse(BaseModel):
    """完整处理响应模型。"""
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    text_list: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="处理后的文本列表")
    chunks: List[ChunkResponse] = Field(default_factory=list, description="文本块列表")
    total_chunks: int = Field(default=0, description="总块数")
    original_length: int = Field(default=0, description="原文长度")
    llm_processed: bool = Field(default=False, description="是否 LLM 处理")
    message: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="消息")


class BatchParseResponse(BaseModel):
    """批量解析响应模型。"""
    
    success: bool = Field(default=True, description="是否成功")
    results: List[ParseResponse] = Field(default_factory=list, description="结果列表")
    total_files: int = Field(default=0, description="文件总数")
    successful_count: int = Field(default=0, description="成功数量")
    failed_count: int = Field(default=0, description="失败数量")


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    """健康检查响应模型。"""
    
    status: str = Field(default="healthy", description="服务状态")
    version: str = Field(default="1.0.0", description="版本号")
    components: Dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="组件状态")


class ConfigResponse(BaseModel):
    """配置信息响应模型。"""
    
    splitter: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="分割器配置")
    llm: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="LLM 配置")
    parser: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="解析器配置")


# ============================================================================
# 全局状态和依赖注入
# ============================================================================

class AppState:
    """应用全局状态。"""
    
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """初始化应用状态。"""
        self.config = DocumentProcessorConfig()
        self.processor: Optional[DocumentProcessor] = None
        self.llm_client: Optional[LLMClient] = None
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="doc_processor_")
        
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        """初始化处理器。"""
        # 检查是否配置了 LLM
        llm_base_url = os.getenv("LLM_BASE_URL", "")
        llm_api_key = os.getenv("LLM_API_KEY", "")
        
        if llm_base_url:
            try:
                self.config.llm = LLMConfig(
                    base_url=llm_base_url,
                    api_key=llm_api_key,
                    model=os.getenv("LLM_MODEL", "gpt-4"),
                )
                self.llm_client = LLMClient(config=self.config.llm)
                logger.info(f"LLM 客户端已初始化: {llm_base_url}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"LLM 客户端初始化失败: {e}")
        
        # 初始化处理器
        self.processor = DocumentProcessor(
            config=self.config,
            llm_client=self.llm_client,
        )
        
        logger.info("文档处理器已初始化")
    
    def cleanup(self) -> None:
        """清理资源。"""
        if self.llm_client:
            self.llm_client.close()
        
        if os.path.exists(self.temp_dir):
            shutil.rmtree(self.temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
        
        logger.info("资源已清理")


# 全局状态实例
app_state = AppState()


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """应用生命周期管理。"""
    logger.info("正在启动文档处理器 API 服务...")
    app_state.initialize()
    yield
    logger.info("正在关闭文档处理器 API 服务...")
    app_state.cleanup()


# ============================================================================
# FastAPI 应用
# ============================================================================

app = FastAPI(
    title="文档处理器 API",
    description="""
## 文档处理器 API

提供文档解析、文本分割和 LLM 处理的 RESTful API 接口。

### 主要功能

- **文档解析**: 支持 PDF、Word、PowerPoint、文本文件
- **文本分割**: 基于中英文句子边界的智能分割
- **LLM 处理**: 文本润色、优化和重组
    """,
    version="1.0.0",
    lifespan=lifespan,
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
)

# CORS 配置
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


# ============================================================================
# 辅助函数
# ============================================================================

def get_processor() -> DocumentProcessor:
    """获取文档处理器实例。"""
    if app_state.processor is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="文档处理器未初始化")
    return app_state.processor


async def save_upload_file(upload_file: UploadFile) -> str:
    """保存上传的文件到临时目录。"""
    file_name = upload_file.filename or "uploaded_file"
    safe_name = Path(file_name).name
    file_path = os.path.join(app_state.temp_dir, safe_name)
    
    base, ext = os.path.splitext(file_path)
    counter = 1
    while os.path.exists(file_path):
        file_path = f"{base}_{counter}{ext}"
        counter += 1
    
    with open(file_path, "wb") as f:
        content = await upload_file.read()
        f.write(content)
    
    return file_path


def cleanup_file(file_path: str) -> None:
    """清理临时文件。"""
    try:
        if os.path.exists(file_path):
            os.remove(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"清理临时文件失败: {file_path}, {e}")


def chunk_to_response(chunk: TextChunk) -> ChunkResponse:
    """将 TextChunk 转换为响应模型。"""
    return ChunkResponse(
        content=chunk.content,
        chunk_index=chunk.chunk_index,
        character_count=len(chunk.content),
        overlap_with_previous=chunk.overlap_with_previous,
        sentence_count=chunk.sentence_count,
    )


# ============================================================================
# API 端点
# ============================================================================

@app.get("/", tags=["Root"])
async def root():
    """根路径，返回 API 信息。"""
    return {
        "name": "文档处理器 API",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "docs": "/docs",
        "health": "/health",
    }


@app.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=["System"])
async def health_check():
    """健康检查接口。"""
    components = {
        "processor": "healthy" if app_state.processor else "not_initialized",
        "llm_client": "healthy" if app_state.llm_client else "not_configured",
    }
    return HealthResponse(status="healthy", version="1.0.0", components=components)


@app.get("/config", response_model=ConfigResponse, tags=["System"])
async def get_config():
    """获取当前配置信息。"""
    return ConfigResponse(
        splitter={
            "chunk_size": app_state.config.splitter.chunk_size,
            "overlap_size": app_state.config.splitter.overlap_size,
        },
        llm={
            "base_url": app_state.config.llm.base_url if app_state.llm_client else None,
            "model": app_state.config.llm.model if app_state.llm_client else None,
            "configured": app_state.llm_client is not None,
        },
        parser={
            "supported_extensions": list(app_state.config.parser.supported_extensions),
        },
    )


@app.post("/api/v1/parse", response_model=ParseResponse, tags=["Document"])
async def parse_document_endpoint(
    file: UploadFile = File(..., description="待解析的文档文件"),
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
):
    """解析上传的文档。"""
    logger.info(f"收到文档解析请求: {file.filename}")
    
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="文件名不能为空")
    
    ext = os.path.splitext(file.filename)[1].lower()
    supported = app_state.config.parser.supported_extensions
    
    if ext not in supported:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"不支持的文件类型: {ext}。支持: {supported}"
        )
    
    file_path = await save_upload_file(file)
    
    try:
        result = parse_document(file_path)
        
        if not result.success:
            return ParseResponse(
                success=False,
                file_name=file.filename,
                file_type=ext,
                error_message=result.error_message,
            )
        
        logger.info(f"文档解析成功: {file.filename}, {len(result.text_content)} 字符")
        
        return ParseResponse(
            success=True,
            file_name=file.filename,
            file_type=ext,
            text_content=result.text_content,
            character_count=len(result.text_content),
            page_count=result.page_count,
            metadata=result.metadata,
        )
    finally:
        if background_tasks:
            background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_file, file_path)
        else:
            cleanup_file(file_path)


@app.post("/api/v1/parse/batch", response_model=BatchParseResponse, tags=["Document"])
async def parse_documents_batch(
    files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="待解析的文档文件列表"),
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
):
    """批量解析多个文档。"""
    logger.info(f"收到批量解析请求: {len(files)} 个文件")
    
    results = []
    file_paths = []
    
    try:
        for file in files:
            if not file.filename:
                results.append(ParseResponse(
                    success=False, file_name="unknown", file_type="",
                    error_message="文件名为空",
                ))
                continue
            
            ext = os.path.splitext(file.filename)[1].lower()
            file_path = await save_upload_file(file)
            file_paths.append(file_path)
            
            try:
                result = parse_document(file_path)
                results.append(ParseResponse(
                    success=result.success,
                    file_name=file.filename,
                    file_type=ext,
                    text_content=result.text_content if result.success else "",
                    character_count=len(result.text_content) if result.success else 0,
                    page_count=result.page_count,
                    metadata=result.metadata,
                    error_message=result.error_message,
                ))
            except Exception as e:
                results.append(ParseResponse(
                    success=False, file_name=file.filename, file_type=ext,
                    error_message=str(e),
                ))
        
        successful = sum(1 for r in results if r.success)
        return BatchParseResponse(
            success=True, results=results, total_files=len(files),
            successful_count=successful, failed_count=len(files) - successful,
        )
    finally:
        for fp in file_paths:
            if background_tasks:
                background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_file, fp)
            else:
                cleanup_file(fp)


@app.post("/api/v1/split", response_model=SplitResponse, tags=["Text Processing"])
async def split_text(request: SplitRequest):
    """分割文本为多个块。"""
    logger.info(f"收到文本分割请求: {len(request.text)} 字符")
    
    try:
        splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(
            chunk_size=request.chunk_size,
            overlap_size=request.overlap_size,
        )
        chunks = splitter.split(request.text)
        stats = splitter.get_stats(chunks)
        chunk_responses = [chunk_to_response(c) for c in chunks]
        
        logger.info(f"文本分割完成: {len(chunks)} 个块")
        
        return SplitResponse(
            success=True,
            chunks=chunk_responses,
            total_chunks=len(chunks),
            original_length=len(request.text),
            stats=stats,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"文本分割失败: {e}", exc_info=True)
        return SplitResponse(success=False, message=str(e))


@app.post("/api/v1/polish", response_model=PolishResponse, tags=["LLM"])
async def polish_texts(request: PolishRequest):
    """使用 LLM 润色文本。输入 text_list，输出 response_list。"""
    logger.info(f"收到文本润色请求: {len(request.text_list)} 个文本")
    
    if not app_state.llm_client:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=503,
            detail="LLM 服务未配置。请设置环境变量 LLM_BASE_URL 和 LLM_API_KEY"
        )
    
    try:
        response_list = app_state.llm_client.process_chunks(
            text_list=request.text_list,
            prompt_name=request.prompt_name,
        )
        
        failed_count = sum(
            1 for orig, resp in zip(request.text_list, response_list)
            if orig == resp
        )
        
        logger.info(f"文本润色完成: {len(response_list)} 个")
        
        return PolishResponse(
            success=True,
            response_list=response_list,
            total_processed=len(response_list),
            failed_count=failed_count,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"文本润色失败: {e}", exc_info=True)
        return PolishResponse(success=False, message=str(e))


@app.post("/api/v1/process", response_model=ProcessResponse, tags=["Pipeline"])
async def process_text(request: ProcessRequest):
    """完整处理文本：分割 + 可选的 LLM 润色。"""
    logger.info(f"收到完整处理请求: {len(request.text)} 字符, use_llm={request.use_llm}")
    
    try:
        splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(
            chunk_size=request.chunk_size,
            overlap_size=request.overlap_size,
        )
        chunks = splitter.split(request.text)
        text_list = [c.content for c in chunks]
        
        llm_processed = False
        if request.use_llm and app_state.llm_client:
            text_list = app_state.llm_client.process_chunks(
                text_list=text_list,
                prompt_name=request.prompt_name,
            )
            llm_processed = True
        elif request.use_llm and not app_state.llm_client:
            logger.warning("请求使用 LLM 但服务未配置")
        
        chunk_responses = [chunk_to_response(c) for c in chunks]
        
        logger.info(f"文本处理完成: {len(chunks)} 个块, LLM: {llm_processed}")
        
        return ProcessResponse(
            success=True,
            text_list=text_list,
            chunks=chunk_responses,
            total_chunks=len(chunks),
            original_length=len(request.text),
            llm_processed=llm_processed,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"文本处理失败: {e}", exc_info=True)
        return ProcessResponse(success=False, message=str(e))


@app.post("/api/v1/process/file", response_model=ProcessResponse, tags=["Pipeline"])
async def process_file(
    file: UploadFile = File(..., description="待处理的文档文件"),
    chunk_size: int = Query(default=512, ge=50, le=10000, description="块大小"),
    overlap_size: int = Query(default=64, ge=0, le=500, description="重叠大小"),
    use_llm: bool = Query(default=False, description="是否使用 LLM"),
    prompt_name: str = Query(default="text_polish", description="提示词名称"),
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
):
    """完整处理文件：解析 + 分割 + 可选的 LLM 润色。"""
    logger.info(f"收到文件处理请求: {file.filename}")
    
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="文件名不能为空")
    
    ext = os.path.splitext(file.filename)[1].lower()
    supported = app_state.config.parser.supported_extensions
    
    if ext not in supported:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"不支持的文件类型: {ext}")
    
    file_path = await save_upload_file(file)
    
    try:
        parsed = parse_document(file_path)
        
        if not parsed.success:
            return ProcessResponse(
                success=False,
                message=f"文档解析失败: {parsed.error_message}",
            )
        
        splitter = RecursiveTextSplitter(chunk_size=chunk_size, overlap_size=overlap_size)
        chunks = splitter.split(parsed.text_content)
        text_list = [c.content for c in chunks]
        
        llm_processed = False
        if use_llm and app_state.llm_client:
            text_list = app_state.llm_client.process_chunks(
                text_list=text_list,
                prompt_name=prompt_name,
            )
            llm_processed = True
        
        chunk_responses = [chunk_to_response(c) for c in chunks]
        
        logger.info(f"文件处理完成: {file.filename}, {len(chunks)} 个块")
        
        return ProcessResponse(
            success=True,
            text_list=text_list,
            chunks=chunk_responses,
            total_chunks=len(chunks),
            original_length=len(parsed.text_content),
            llm_processed=llm_processed,
        )
    finally:
        if background_tasks:
            background_tasks.add_task(cleanup_file, file_path)
        else:
            cleanup_file(file_path)


# ============================================================================
# 错误处理
# ============================================================================

@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
async def http_exception_handler(request, exc: HTTPException):
    """HTTP 异常处理。"""
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        content={"success": False, "error": exc.detail, "status_code": exc.status_code},
    )


@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def general_exception_handler(request, exc: Exception):
    """通用异常处理。"""
    logger.error(f"未处理的异常: {exc}", exc_info=True)
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=500,
        content={"success": False, "error": "服务器内部错误", "detail": str(exc)},
    )


# ============================================================================
# 主入口
# ============================================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    
    host = os.getenv("HOST", "0.0.0.0")
    port = int(os.getenv("PORT", "8000"))
    reload = os.getenv("RELOAD", "false").lower() == "true"
    
    logger.info(f"启动服务器: {host}:{port}")
    
    uvicorn.run("app:app", host=host, port=port, reload=reload, log_level="info")
